content: पार्षत {%a.%} (-ती|{%f.%}) Belonging to the spotted antelope; <ls>Ms. 3. 269</ls>; <ls>Y. 1. 257</ls>. .{@-तः@} A patronymic of king Drupada, and of his son Dhṛṣṭadyumna; <ls>Mb. 1. 138. 20</ls>, <ls n="Mb.">7. 7. 3</ls>. .{@-ती@} A patronymic of Draupadī.
पार्षती .²1 An epithet of Draupadī; सूतस्येति वचः श्रुत्वा पार्षती दुःखिताऽवदत् <ls>Bm. 2. 369</ls>. .²2 Of Durgā.
